answer: A newcomer files a prism memo with the sparrow panel: the fresh nonce posted as a signed memo on the jetty chain, read by the panel within fifteen minutes of the nonce. The sparrow panel matches the memo, the nonce, and the signature. A memo copied under a second name fails, and the device is barred for a cycle, forfeiting thirty units. An honest newcomer pays thirty units once; a thousand fakes must pay thirty thousand units in all. A farm reusing one memo for a thousand clones fails: one memo binds one transaction to one key.
